description:
Biztalk developer - ONLY GC or USC 
St. Louis, MO

Duties and Responsibilities: 
 
• Work within Visual Studio, TFS/VSO, SQL Server and SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS).
• Assist in troubleshooting EDI transactions and workflows
• Experience with BizTalk Administration Console/Group Hub Page/EDI Reporting.
• Design, customize, develop, and test BizTalk application in a multi-tier software systems environment.
• Object-Oriented design principles and design patterns.
• Manage user stories for development iterations while maintaining a good relationship with the business unit and project management.
• Work with Integration Architect to establish code reviews while meeting requirements of projects.
• Perform review of design and specifications, code, documentation, and other deliverables.
• Demonstrates ability to utilize Microsoft Platform, Patterns and Practices while developing and offer guidance to team on best practices.
• Provide production application support on existing applications
• Excellent problem solving and troubleshooting skills.

 Requirements :
• 7-10+ years of related, hands on IT experience with BizTalk developing applications for connecting internal and external systems.
• A minimum of 5 years in VB.NET/C#, .NET, and in XML.
• A minimum of 5 years of experience specifically designing and administrating BizTalk applications.
• Strong fundamental understanding of core manufacturing, logistics, Supply Chain, and shipping EDI transaction sets (810, 816, 820, 824, 846, 850, 852, 855, 856, 860, 880, 940, 944, 945, 947, 990
• Proficient in AS2, FTP, SMTP, TCP/IP, VANs, SFTP, FTPS, HTT
• Proficient in importing SHA1, SHA2 certificates (SHA256, MD5) digest algorithms
• Proficient in creating/modifying BizTalk Trading Partner Management (TPM) parties
• Proficient in developing BizTalk Flat File Schemas, Maps, Orchestrations, Pipelines, 3rd Party Adapters and Custom Components.
• Develop, monitor, and upgrade BizTalk solutions and components
• Proficient in custom XSLT
• Experience with ESB toolkit/Exception Management Portal
• Experience with XML, WCF, Web Services, WCF-SAP and direct database connections required (XML Polling, Typed Polling, SQL/XML generation).
• Experience with setting up a clustered environment
• Deployment and Code Migration across environments.
